name: Warden Coll
role: Edge District Warden — the official who can be reached, and who moves on what he is told without needing it explained twice
appearance: Fifties, square, District greys kept correct rather than smart. A satchel of standing paperwork he actually reads. The kind of face that has been told bad news at a desk many times and has stopped reacting to the telling.
physicality: Listens without interrupting and then moves, which people find abrupt because they expected discussion.
voiceHints: Names exactly what he needs in order to act, without hedging, and does not explain why he needs it. Builds a decision out loud while you are still talking.
wants: To be told the thing early enough to matter.
fears: Being the last to know about something he had the authority to stop.
knowledge: That Edvar Crane held a Wright's commission at the Crossing before the Accord — fold-work in the disputed corridor
That Crane's files went to the Deep Registry, Ossian annex, two streets north, green shutter — and that the committee's name opens the Zone Remediation index
Maren Ossitide by reputation: a legendary Ashwarden whose movements track toward the Zone, not summonable, who finds the work she is meant to find
That the water crisis connects to a larger pole-pull affecting the Radiant Reach

reactsToReputation.any: hears you out without interrupting, then tells you what he will do
reactsToReputation.useful: gives you the next name in the chain before you ask for it
reactsToReputation.evasive: stops taking notes, which is how you know

questSeeds: He has the authority to act and is usually told too late
The Deep Registry's Ossian annex holds what was filed and not destroyed
gear: a District warden's short blade, worn and unused
